formal_role: Identifies a state where modeled rate of change is zero
systems_modeling_role: Represents possible balance boundary threshold or operating condition
review_warning: Equilibrium candidates must be checked against the meaningful domain of the model

formal_role: Describes behavior after small perturbations near equilibrium
systems_modeling_role: Indicates whether small disturbances tend to shrink grow or remain inconclusive
review_warning: Local stability does not guarantee global resilience

formal_role: Approximates nonlinear behavior near equilibrium using derivatives or Jacobians
systems_modeling_role: Supports local interpretation of recovery instability oscillation or saddle behavior
review_warning: Linearization may fail when first derivatives vanish or nonlinear terms dominate

formal_role: Restrict states to meaningful values such as nonnegative or bounded intervals
systems_modeling_role: Preserve physical ecological social or institutional interpretability
review_warning: Mathematically valid equilibria may be invalid outside the system domain

formal_role: Identifies initial conditions that approach a stable state or attractor
systems_modeling_role: Supports resilience threshold and recovery interpretation
review_warning: Basin boundaries are often uncertain and may depend on unmodeled variables

formal_role: Defines how equilibrium and local dynamics are explored computationally
systems_modeling_role: Supports reproducible simulation initial-condition sweeps and solver review
review_warning: Step size and solver choice can create misleading stability behavior
